command:
bash -lc 'LOCK=/tmp/c720p-job-990013.lock; mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; echo BEFORE=$(date -Is); SVC=; for s in home-assistant.service homeassistant.service; do if systemctl --user status "$s" >/dev/null 2>&1; then SVC=$s; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$SVC" ]; then for s in home-assistant.service homeassistant.service; do if systemctl status "$s" >/dev/null 2>&1; then SVC=system:$s; break; fi; done; fi; echo SVC=$SVC; if [[ $SVC == system:* ]]; then sudo -n systemctl restart "${SVC#system:}" || exit 31; else systemctl --user restart "$SVC" || exit 32; fi; ok=0; for i in $(seq 1 45); do code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 2 http://localhost:8123/c720p-hub/home 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$code" = 200 ]; then ok=1; break; fi; sleep 1; done; echo HA_READY=$ok; sleep 8; python3 - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import sqlite3,time,pathlib
ids=["light.woonkamer_plafond","light.plafond_office","light.lsc_smart_connect_gu10_rgb_cct","light.lsc_smart_connect_gu10_rgb_cct_2","light.lsc_smart_connect_gu10_rgb_cct_3"]
p=pathlib.Path("/opt/homeassistant/config/home-assistant_v2.db")
try:
 d=sqlite3.connect(f"file:{p}?mode=ro",uri=True,timeout=3)
 q="select sm.entity_id,s.state from states s join states_meta sm on sm.metadata_id=s.metadata_id join (select metadata_id,max(state_id) z from states group by metadata_id) m on m.z=s.state_id where sm.entity_id in (%s)" % ",".join("?"*len(ids))
 st=dict(d.execute(q,ids)); print("TUYA="+";".join(x+"="+st.get(x,"missing") for x in ids))
except Exception as e: print("TUYAERR="+repr(e))
try:
 lines=pathlib.Path("/opt/homeassistant/config/home-assistant.log").read_text(errors="ignore").splitlines()[-2500:]
 hits=[x for x in lines if "tuya" in x.lower() and ("error" in x.lower() or "failed" in x.lower())]
 print("LASTERR="+(hits[-1][-900:] if hits else "NONE"))
except Exception as e: print("LOGERR="+repr(e))
PY'
